content: Kepauka Kakaɨyari kiita pemeutahani, pe'a'ɨwiyatɨ kepemɨtiuyeikakɨ kene'enieka keyuri pe'iyetuirienike mawari 'atsimemɨkatemate wahepaɨ, mɨkɨ 'axameteyuriekame mepɨkayu'erie.

content.text: kemɨ'aneta waɨkawa mutaniuka yakɨ xeikɨa katinikuxatani.

content: Kepauka Kakaɨyari hetsɨa tixaɨtɨkɨ pemɨti'ahɨritɨa, 'apepɨkareutewini yapemɨtikayanikɨ, Kakaɨyari matsi pɨkayutemawie yamemɨkatekahu wahetsiemieme. Kenaye'atɨa kepemutayɨkɨ:

'Ateni pepɨkapitɨaka kapa 'axapetiuyurienikɨ, yapepɨkahaineni Kakaɨyari tupirieya hɨxie, kename yapekara'eriwamekɨ petiuyuri. ¿Titayari matsi Kakaɨyari petihaxɨatɨa mɨyape'utaitɨ naime mɨtika'unakɨ 'a'uximayatsika?
Matsi waɨkawa xɨkaxuaweni tixaɨtɨ mɨkatihɨkɨ, heinɨtsi 'axa'anenetɨ tiyu'uximatɨwatɨ, yakɨxeikɨa waɨkawa mayeniuwenikɨ, 'ekɨ matsi Kakaɨyari kenayemakaxeni.

Xɨka xeime kwieyaritsie pewaruxeiya mewananaimakame tixaɨtɨ memɨkatehexeiya, meta teɨteri mekawapitɨatɨ heitserie memexeiyanikɨ, mɨkɨkɨ pepɨkahɨxiyaka, kemɨ'ane waɨkawa muwe'eme xewitɨ matsi waɨkawa we'emetɨtɨ kanixeiyani, meta waheima matsi xewitɨ mariwetɨ kaniwaxeiyani.
Kamɨtsɨ 'ikɨ naimekɨ tixaɨtɨ pɨkatixuawe 'aixɨa mɨti'ane 'ikɨ kwieyaritsie, mɨraka'etsitɨretsieri mɨti'ɨwiyani peuyewetse ti'aitame.
Tumini kemɨ'ane mɨnakie'erie, pɨkatahɨniwe tuminikɨ. Kemɨ'ane waɨkawa mɨrexeiyanikɨ mɨyɨane matsi waɨkawa pɨreuyehɨwa. Mɨkɨta yaxeikɨa tixaɨtɨ pɨkatihɨkɨ.
Hakewa waɨkawa mɨrexuawe, kananuyuhayewanita mitixɨtɨanikɨ, ¿ketita 'aixɨa mɨti'ane kamɨtsɨ tiutixuaweriyaxɨ kutsiyarieya 'ixeiyaka xeikɨa?
Ti'uximayatame 'aixɨa 'anemekɨ kaniukakukutsuni, heiwa waɨkawa tiutikwa'atɨ heiwa 'etsiwa xeikɨa. Mɨxikuta waɨkawa mɨrexeiyakɨ piiniteya pɨka'ipitɨa 'aixɨa 'iyari mɨkutsunikɨ.
Hikɨ tukaritsie nepɨtixeiya waɨkawa 'axamɨti'ane: waɨkawa tumini muti'utakɨ xeikɨa kemɨ'ane miti'utaxɨ mu'uximatɨarienikɨ,
meta mɨkɨ piinitɨarika pɨreuyewautse hau'erietɨ xɨka petita'uximayatsitɨani. Mɨkɨ kutsiyarieya xɨka heiwa yuniwe hexeiyatɨ 'ayani tixaɨtɨri pɨkarexeiyani miku'eiririenikɨ.
Ke'anetɨ mutinuiwaxɨ yumaamatsie, mɨpaɨta 'anetɨ kaniyemieni: mawetɨ kemɨtinua 'ena kwiepa, tixaɨtɨ pɨkaranutɨni waɨkawa yu'uximayatsikatsie timieme.
Mɨkɨ matsi mari'itɨarika kanihɨkɨtɨni: ke'anetɨ mɨnua tewi mɨpaɨ 'anetɨta kaniyemieni. ¿Ketitayari kamɨtsɨ waɨkawa rexeiyani tixaɨtɨ karayanikeyu?
'Imatɨrieka kepaɨmexɨa muyeikani yɨwipa katinikwakamɨkɨ, meta waɨkawa 'uximatɨarietɨ katinikuyekamɨkɨ 'ayu'eriyatɨ.

'Ikɨ kanihɨkɨtɨni kenemɨretima: 'ikɨ tukaritsie 'aixɨa kani'aneni matsi mɨtiutikwa'ani mɨranuye'eni, ketipaɨmeme pemɨrexeiyakɨ pe'atemawietɨ matsi ketinekwaka. Mɨkɨ kanihɨkɨtɨni Kakaɨyari mɨtatsiyetuiri, mɨkɨ tahetsie mɨtiunakixɨ pɨhɨkɨ.
Matsi Kakaɨyari kemɨ'ane mɨtiyetuirie waɨkawa mɨrexeiyanikɨ, kaniyetuiriekata yu'uximayatsikatsie timieme mɨtikwakakɨta, mɨkɨ kanihɨkɨtɨni Kakaɨyari kemɨtatimikwa teyuxexuime.
Kakaɨyari wa'iyaritsie kemɨtiwahɨniya temawierikakɨ, tewi yutukari 'etsiwa xeikɨa kaniku'eriwani.
